ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent charges against 15 individuals and the state's efforts to cut off thousands of providers
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's efforts to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the effectiveness of the state's efforts to prevent and detect it
